description: Source code for Android camera management, including implementation of ACameraManager and CameraManagerGlobal classes, handling camera service connection, callbacks, and camera device operations.

classes.name: CameraManagerGlobal
classes.description: Singleton class managing connection to the camera service, handling callbacks, and camera device status.

classes.name: CameraManagerGlobal::CallbackHandler
classes.description: Handles asynchronous callback messages for camera availability and status changes.

classes.name: CameraManagerGlobal::CameraServiceListener
classes.description: Listener for camera service events such as status changes and priority updates.

classes.name: CameraManagerGlobal::StatusAndHAL3Support
classes.description: Tracks camera status and HAL3 support per camera.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::~CameraManagerGlobal
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and unregistering callbacks.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::getCameraService
methods.description: Returns the camera service interface, establishing connection if needed.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::getCameraServiceLocked
methods.description: Internal method to get or initialize camera service connection.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::onCameraAccessPrioritiesChanged
methods.description: Handles camera access priority change events.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::onStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles camera status change events for logical cameras.

methods.name: CameraManagerGlobal::onStatusChangedLocked
methods.description: Internal method to process camera status updates with locking.

methods.name: ACameraManager::getCameraIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of available camera IDs.

methods.name: ACameraManager::deleteCameraIdList
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for camera ID list.

methods.name: ACameraManager::getCameraCharacteristics
methods.description: Fetches camera characteristics for a given camera ID.

methods.name: ACameraManager::openCamera
methods.description: Opens a camera device with specified ID and callbacks.
